title: Ragusa orders 30-day plague isolation
summary: During the plague, the Republic of Ragusa first imposed a thirty-day isolation on arrivals; the later forty-day rule gave quarantine its name.
why: Forerunner of the forty-day quarantine, still a key tool against epidemics.

notes.problem: Title claims the first quarantine; source lists earlier isolation (Leviticus, early Islamic leprosy quarantine, Venice 1348) and dates the 40-day term to 1448.
